name: spotlight
description: The viewer's spotlight: a smooth cone from a lamp toward a target, brightness over attenuation times distance squared, over a 0.25 floor. The blog lit rooms (a lamp 6 m up, an 80 degree cone, attenuation 0.5); here the lamp hangs above and in front of the scan with a 30 degree cone. Click the scan to aim it.
